Emma (CSM): Heads-up — Acme is hitting us with a quality + perf complaint on vector search/rerank after the rollout last night. They say top-3 are often irrelevant and rerank is adding noticeable latency. They mentioned pausing until we fix. Ticket #123456.

Tony (Support): Can you paste 1-2 reproducible queries and the expected vs actual top docs? Also need requestIDs + p50/p95 latency figures.

Emma (CSM): Sample below from customer (copied):
```
query: "refund for duplicate charge"
expected_top: [inv_321, faq_refund, inv_78]
actual_top: [marketing_banner, blog_67, inv_78]
rerank_stage: applied (rerank-model v2.1)
rerank_latency_p95: 380ms
embedding_dim_reported: 768
support_ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-123456
```

Raj (ML Eng): :eyes: Did the customer update their embed generation code or change the embedding model? Also, which index and similarity metric are they using? If rerank model changed weights it could surface off-topic docs.

Emma (CSM): They say no infra/client changes on their side; they saw the drop immediately after our deploy (timestamp approx 1757999000). Index is internal vecstore (cosine).

deploy-bot: rerank-model v2.1 deployed at 1757999000 by @ci/cd (release pipeline).

Tony (Support): Ok — I'll attach the `raw_request_id` and a few docs for offline repro. Also collecting the top-k raw similarity scores and the raw embeddings for the query + docs.

Lina (PM): We should triage to product backlog and treat as a higher-priority regression. Proposed acceptance criteria for a backlog ticket (suggested):
- Reproduce customer issue with provided query/dataset on staging
- Identify root cause: model regression vs scoring/feature bug
- If model regression, either rollback v2.1 or patch weights with clear A/B test plan
- Restore expected top-3 for the repro queries (customer-provided)
- Rerank p95 latency must be reduced to <200ms for their workload or provide documented mitigation (batching/async)
- Add automated regression test (small eval set) to prevent recurrence

Lina (PM): Assigning to Raj to investigate. Please update the ticket with earliest ETA. I recommend P1 until we confirm scope — customer is revenue at risk. :warning:

Raj (ML Eng): On it. First pass I'll run the repro with v2.0 (previous) vs v2.1 on staging and diff the score distributions. If model is the issue, recommend rollback and then quick patch. Will report back by EOD.

Tony (Support): Created backlog: PROD-7892 (Customer: Acme — vector relevancy regression). Linked support ticket CS-123456 -> PROD-7892.

Emma (CSM): Thanks team. Please ping me before any rollback so I can prep the customer comms. :thumbsup:

Lina (PM): Add timeline in ticket: 4h triage update, EOD action plan. If rollback required, aim for rollback within 8h.

Raj (ML Eng): Acknowledged. Starting with data pull now.

Emma (CSM): Customer asked for a short summary for their legal/comms team — I'll draft once we have the cause.

Tony (Support): I'll attach logs + request IDs to both tickets and flag for priority. :white_check_mark:

Lina (PM): Thanks everyone. We'll treat this as incident-adjacent until resolved. :eyes:
